updates.title: School enrolment cap increased to 156
updates.content: Demountable staying and included in enrolments. New DoE leadership more flexible and open-minded. Some constraints around funding and assets lifted.

updates.title: Playground markings — student voice groups choosing designs
updates.content: Top oval. Handball and fitness circuit most popular. 4-5 weeks to installation. LED installation planned for 24 Feb.

updates.title: Uniform transition period until 31 December 2027
updates.content: Students can wear old or new uniform during transition. Lowes phasing out older stock from 2025. New skorts and shorts now available. Winter items and jacket coming soon.

updates.title: Explicit teaching embedded across numeracy and literacy
updates.content: School made significant strides embedding explicit teaching. Daily warm-up activities, number sense routines, guided reading enhancements. Regular use of student data for targeted support.

updates.title: AI EduChat being introduced for Stage 3 students
updates.content: Introducing explicit instruction for Stage 3 to effectively utilise AI tools such as AI EduChat to support learning.

updates.title: 4 classes in 2026, no 3-way classes
updates.content: Gaining 20 kindy students, losing 12 Year 6, losing 4 throughout. Ms Nash extra staff until transfer.
